newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest grains price drop slows in sluggish mkt.
newsitem.headline: Budapest grains price drop slows in sluggish mkt.

text.p: The fall in grains prices on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) slowed down on Wednesday in moderate volumes, after Tuesday's limit-down wheat price movements.
Milling wheat prices dropped 100 to 390 forints per tonne for most maturities except for May, which remained flat, and September, which rose 80 forints to 21,600.
Maize prices remained trendless as harvesting time was still too far away for reliable crop forecasts and in the absence of other information to trade on.
Maize futures eased 20 to 170 forints for July, October, December and March while other maturities, which were untraded, remained flat.
Maize turnover dropped to 65 lots from Tuesday's 392.
Milling wheat was the most traded contract, accounting for 547 lots, the bulk of Wednesday's turnover of 812 lots or 328.16 million forints.
